description: This file contains helper functions for extracting and setting JSON values using the cJSON library, including functions for strings, integers, doubles, and booleans.

methods.name: getCJSONString
methods.description: Extracts a string value from a JSON object given a key.

methods.name: getCJSONInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a JSON object given a key.

methods.name: getCJSONDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value from a JSON object given a key.

methods.name: getCJSONBool
methods.description: Extracts a boolean value from a JSON object given a key.

methods.name: setCJSONBool
methods.description: Sets the boolean value of a cJSON object.
